hotspots.name: Iran war & Persian Gulf
hotspots.summary: The fighting spread to Kuwait overnight on 17–18 Nov: Kuwait's air defences engaged hostile drones, and Iran's regular army said it hit US Patriot systems at Ali Al Salem Air Base in retaliation for the US strike on an IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island; damage is unverified and Trump said Washington is 'looking into it'. Iran also claims it shot down a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz. The GCC, Qatar and the UAE condemned the attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain, the GCC urged UN Security Council action, and Kuwait invoked its right to self-defence. In the strait, the LPG carrier Tara Gas, abandoned after a second strike north of Khasab, was still burning on 18 Nov with one crew member missing and 11 injured, and Iran claims three more tankers hit mines. Araghchi's talks in Muscat ended without agreement; Iran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade, releases frozen assets and eases sanctions, terms Washington calls unacceptable. Trump, who says a deal is 'very close', meets Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on 19 Nov with the Iran war on the agenda. Three US carrier groups are in the region, CENTCOM's commander visits Israel on 18 Nov, and Iran still refuses to resume IAEA inspections.

Israeli jets struck Kfar Tibnit and several other southern Lebanon villages on 9 Nov, and Israeli forces shelled Haddatha on 14 Nov, despite the June framework deal on a gradual Israeli withdrawal; on 10 Nov unidentified attackers fired at a UNIFIL patrol near Wadi Jilu. Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israeli attacks since 2 March have killed 4,390 people. In Gaza, an Israeli drone strike killed two people in Jabaliya on 14 Nov after tank fire killed three in Deir al-Balah and a baby died of cold on 13 Nov; the EU is urging Israel to let in flood aid and reopen all crossings. In Israel, caretaker PM Netanyahu renewed his call on 14 Nov for a unity government to 'eliminate the Iranian threat once and for all', which Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a government, rejected. hotspots.name: Russia–Ukraine war
hotspots.summary: A section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed early on 17 Nov after a Ukrainian strike, reportedly with a Flamingo cruise missile; Zelensky said it was the last stage of a seven-phase operation over several weeks that first destroyed air defences, radars and electronic-warfare systems along the route. Russia suspended road and rail traffic. Hours earlier Russia fired seven ballistic missiles at Kyiv's North and South bridges over the Dnipro; the Southern Bridge partly reopened on 17 Nov, and two people were killed in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district. Fires were reported overnight at the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex in Bashkortostan amid a drone attack, and seven Russian drones strayed into Moldova, one over Chisinau. EU foreign ministers on 16 Nov listed 113 more people and entities, including 47 banks and refiners such as Kirishi, Omsk and Orsk. Zelensky has proposed humanitarian operations in 10 more occupied settlements and says a large prisoner exchange agreed in Abu Dhabi could happen within weeks. Putin arrived in Shenzhen on 17 Nov for APEC; Trump says he will raise the war with Putin and Xi there, though aides say it is not on the three-way agenda.

hotspots.name: Yemen & Red Sea

On the ground, government forces have reinforced Tur al-Baha in Lahij, about 85 km from Aden and described as the city's first line of defence, and are building sandbag defences and tunnels around Aden as Houthi fighters hold positions to the west; clashes continue in Lahij and in Taiz, where Houthis are accused of shelling villages in Jabal Sabr. The Houthis took the Khor Omairah coast on 16 Nov after the Southern Armed Forces quit Dhubab and the Bab al-Mandab area on 15 Nov, and King Salman has named Gen. Fayyad al-Ruwaili to command the joint forces. Yemen's parliament has voted to designate the Houthis a terrorist organisation. The WHO has counted at least 1,771 killed and more than 300,000 displaced since August, and most Asia–Europe container services still sail around Africa.

news.headline: EU names five countries to represent Europe in Ukraine peace talks
news.summary: European Council President Costa said the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Poland will join the EU at the next round of talks, though the Kremlin has not confirmed Europe's inclusion.

news.headline: Russian strikes kill a rescuer in Zaporizhzhia and two in Odesa
news.summary: A five-storey block in Zaporizhzhia was badly damaged and a rescuer died when a slab collapsed, while a strike on a house in Odesa killed two and injured five.

news.headline: Iran says three more oil tankers hit mines and caught fire in Hormuz
news.summary: Iran's IRGC navy said two tankers, one a supertanker, exploded after hitting a mine in the south of the strait and its regular navy said a third caught fire east of it; the ships were not named, and the US says it has cleared the main routes of mines.

news.headline: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on new Iran strikes absent provocations
news.summary: Officials say Trump has not settled on a course but may refrain from renewed strikes if Iran and the Houthis make no new provocations, as Iran's navy said more tankers that switched off tracking hit mines in Hormuz.

news.headline: Sudan army takes Al-Khuway in West Kordofan
news.summary: The army took the main West Kordofan town of Al-Khuway on Friday, local media report, extending gains after breaking the RSF siege of El-Obeid and opening routes toward Babanusa.

news.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way meeting in Shenzhen
news.summary: The White House says the three leaders will meet on the sidelines of APEC in Shenzhen next week, with Trump raising the Iran war and nuclear arms but not Ukraine; a US official said no agreement is expected.

news.headline: Coalition destroys Houthi drones aimed at Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia
news.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi drones on Saturday, as Houthi media reported coalition strikes on southern parts of Saada city.

news.headline: Ukraine hits Samara oil pumping station and Lipetsk airbase
news.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said oil tanks caught fire at the Samara pumping station near Prosvet, which blends Urals export crude, and that it struck the Lipetsk-2 military airfield on 13 Nov.

news.headline: Russian attacks wound 22 in Zaporizhzhia, including three children
news.summary: Strikes on the Voznesenivskyi, Khortytskyi and Zavodskyi districts damaged homes and an infrastructure site, a drone killed a man in nearby Kushuhum, and traffic over the DniproHES dam was halted.

news.headline: Zelensky says US floated NATO membership in exchange for leaving Donbas
news.summary: Zelensky said US negotiators asked whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of Donbas it still holds if it joined NATO; he refused to cede territory but said he would put a full package of guarantees and funding to a referendum.

news.headline: Car bomb near Damascus kills a father and his daughter
news.summary: A suspected explosive device in a parked car went off in Jaramana, a Druze and Christian suburb of Damascus, killing two and seriously injuring the man's wife; security forces opened an investigation.

news.headline: Netanyahu urges unity government to end Iran threat; Eisenkot refuses
news.summary: The caretaker prime minister proposed talks without preconditions, saying only a unity government could eliminate the Iranian threat; Eisenkot, tasked with forming a government, said Netanyahu knows he lost the election.

news.headline: Drones hit three merchant ships off Romania's Black Sea coast
news.summary: A cargo ship was hit near Sfântu Gheorghe on 13 Nov and the tanker Evia Petrol V and bulker Marsol caught fire near Sulina on 14 Nov; no one was hurt and Romania is investigating where the drones came from.

news.headline: Saudi Arabia intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh
news.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said air defences destroyed two ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and three drones over the Eastern Province early on Sunday, with no casualties reported.

news.headline: Iran fires drones at US radar in Bahrain for a second time; Bahrain intercepts
news.summary: The IRGC said six drones targeted a US air-defence radar at the Riffa helicopter base in what it called a second round of retaliation; Bahrain issued its first nationwide alert in months and said its air defences destroyed the attacks, with no damage or casualties reported and no US confirmation.

news.headline: DRC–Rwanda rift overshadows Francophonie summit in Phnom Penh
news.summary: The DRC dropped its own candidate and backed Romania's Dacian Ciolos to block a third term for Rwanda's Louise Mushikiwabo as secretary-general, having threatened to quit the organisation if she wins.

news.headline: Ghalibaf says Iran is ready for talks or war as Araghchi heads to Oman
news.summary: Parliament speaker Ghalibaf said Iran will not accept 'neither war nor peace' and a deal is possible if the US accepts its seven conditions; the foreign ministry said Iran would accept no nuclear commitments for now, and Araghchi is due in Muscat on Tuesday.

news.headline: Yemeni government forces pull back from Bab al-Mandab, leaving Houthis overlooking the strait
news.summary: The Southern Armed Forces announced a redeployment from Dhubab airport and the Bab al-Mandab area toward Aden, reversing October's offensive and leaving the Houthis in control of the coast overlooking the shipping chokepoint.

news.headline: Russia launches 'mass attack' on Odesa Oblast; strikes kill 4 across Ukraine
news.summary: Russia launched 132 drones overnight; a strike on a DTEK energy site cut power to about 41,000 families in Odesa Oblast, two men were killed in Mena in Chernihiv Oblast, and 32 were injured in Zaporizhzhia over the past day.

news.headline: Sudan army seizes three more areas as it closes on RSF-held Al-Nuhud
news.summary: Military sources say the army and allies took Khamasat, Markab and Umm Oweisha east of Al-Nuhud on Saturday, a day after capturing Al-Khuway, as they advance on West Kordofan's second city.

news.headline: Ukraine strikes Akhtubinsk military airfield deep inside Russia
news.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it hit the Akhtubinsk airbase in Astrakhan Oblast and a drone launch site in Oryol Oblast overnight; at least 30 explosions were reported at the airfield, which the Kyiv Independent could not verify.

news.headline: EU forces board suspected Russian shadow-fleet tanker in the Mediterranean
news.summary: Kaja Kallas said Operation Irini boarded the tanker MIDAG on 13 Nov and found it sailing under a false flag, a day before EU foreign ministers are due to approve new shadow-fleet sanctions listings.

news.headline: Israel kills Hamas Rafah Brigade commander in al-Mawasi strike
news.summary: The IDF said an overnight strike in southern Gaza killed Samir Abu Younis, who took over Hamas's Rafah Brigade two months ago, and Al-Qassam Brigades confirmed his death near Khan Younis.

news.headline: Iran says a supertanker carrying 2 million barrels sank after hitting a mine
news.summary: The IRGC said an unnamed supertanker sank in southern Gulf waters after striking a mine and a second tanker caught fire; there is no independent confirmation, while UKMTO separately reported a tanker attacked in the Gulf before entering Hormuz with its crew safe.

news.headline: Houthis near Lahij as government troops fall back toward Aden
news.summary: Government forces have pulled back to al-Suqyah, about 150 km west of Aden, with Houthi fighters reported near Tur al-Bahah 80 km north of the city, while the ICRC confirmed the Houthis released 600 prisoners.

news.headline: Iran says it will not wait for a US attack; US Embassy in Bahrain issues security alert
news.summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran will not wait for the US to strike first and suggested Washington may be using diplomacy to buy time, as the US Embassy in Manama warned Americans of possible attacks by Iran and the Houthis.

news.headline: USS Theodore Roosevelt arrives, giving the US three carriers in the Middle East
news.summary: A US official said the carrier reached Central Command's area on 15 Nov, joining the USS George Washington it was meant to relieve, as Iran claimed fresh drone attacks on US forces in Bahrain.

news.headline: Crimean Bridge reportedly struck as Russia claims a record 1,336 Ukrainian drones
news.summary: Crimea's Russian-installed head imposed temporary traffic limits on the Kerch bridge after a reported strike on a navigable-span arch, while Moscow said it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, about 600 of them aimed at Moscow Oblast; the damage and the drone count are unverified.

news.headline: Israel strikes Bekaa Valley, saying it hit a weapons shipment bound for Hezbollah
news.summary: Israel said its jets hit a shipment that had crossed from Syria in the Janta area near the Syrian border, its first strike there in months; Lebanon's NNA reported no casualties.

news.headline: IRGC claims it took control of a US drone by electronic warfare
news.summary: The Guards said their drone unit seized the guidance system of a US MQM-170 drone over a southern island, a claim not independently confirmed, as Araghchi urged closer energy cooperation among regional producers.

news.headline: Trump heads to Manila, then Shenzhen summit with Xi and Putin
news.summary: Trump meets regional leaders in Manila on Tuesday before APEC in Shenzhen, where Beijing's priority is reportedly blocking a $14 billion US arms package for Taiwan that Trump calls a 'negotiating chip'.

news.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Ilsky refinery and Azov oil depot in southern Russia
news.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said three crude units at the Ilsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai were damaged overnight, and Rostov's governor said an oil depot and gas station in Azov caught fire, injuring three.

news.headline: EU lists 113 more Russia targets, including 49 banks and major refiners
news.summary: Foreign ministers sanctioned banks, refineries such as Kirishi and Omsk, and shadow-fleet firms, plus a Kremlin troll factory and hacker group, as Kallas called Moscow's peace demands 'absurd'.

news.headline: Sudan's army says it took five areas from the RSF in West Kordofan
news.summary: The army says it seized Al-Saatat localities northeast of Abu Zabad, on the El-Obeid–Dilling road, and villages east of Al-Nuhud; the RSF has not commented.

news.headline: Russian attacks kill 6 and injure 45 across Ukraine in a day
news.summary: A strike on a road in Dnipro killed one and injured 13, three died in Druzhkivka, and overnight drone attacks on energy sites cut power in six oblasts as Kyiv saw more than 20 air-raid alerts.

news.headline: Houthis seize more of Yemen's southern coast, edging closer to Aden
news.summary: Military sources say the Houthis took the Khor Omairah coast about 100 km west of Aden and are 25 km from government lines at Qawah, a day after government forces quit the Bab al-Mandab area to defend the city.

news.headline: Lukashenko orders snap combat-readiness check of Belarus border units
news.summary: Belarus's Security Council said border-guard rapid-response units will march and repel simulated sabotage attacks, without saying where; Ukraine's border service called such drills 'information pressure'.

news.headline: Iran offers to reopen Hormuz in two days; Pakistan awaits US reply
news.summary: At an Economic Cooperation Organization meeting in Islamabad, Araghchi said regional states back Iran's plan to reopen the strait within two days if the US lifts its blockade, releases frozen assets and eases sanctions; Pakistan's Ishaq Dar said Islamabad is waiting for Washington's answer.

news.headline: Estonia summons Russian envoy over alleged GRU arson attempt on drone maker
news.summary: Estonia accuses Russian military intelligence of trying to set fire to drone manufacturer Threod Systems near Tallinn early on 14 Nov, and summoned Russia's charge d'affaires.

news.headline: Second tanker in a day disabled by engine-room fire off Oman
news.summary: UKMTO said a tanker about 7 nm north of Khasab was left disabled with an engine-room fire, after another outbound tanker was hit by a projectile earlier on 16 Nov; crews are safe and no one has claimed either attack.

news.headline: Seven Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv's North and South bridges
news.summary: Zelensky said four missiles hit the South Bridge and three the North Bridge, closing both and cutting part of the metro's Green Line, while the wider attack caused power cuts in Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia oblasts.

news.headline: Trump reaches Manila for the ASEAN summit close before China trip
news.summary: Trump arrived for the summit's final day amid protests, and said a possible meeting with Kim Jong Un would take place in China and depend on Xi; he expects to meet Xi and Putin, with Ukraine and Iran on the agenda.

news.headline: Section of the Crimean Bridge collapses after reported Ukrainian strike
news.summary: An arch and the roadway between two supports fell into the Kerch Strait overnight; Russia suspended road and rail traffic and reported no casualties, and an unverified video appears to show a Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile.

news.headline: Yemen's parliament designates Houthis a terrorist group as army claims 661 attacks
news.summary: The government says it struck Houthi positions 661 times on fronts in Taiz, Marib and al-Jawf, while the Houthis cut a key supply route along the Red Sea coast as they push toward Aden.

news.headline: Saudi-backed forces dig in around Aden as Houthis hold positions 60 km away
news.summary: Fighting is intense on the mountains overlooking Bab el-Mandeb as government forces regroup to defend Aden and break the siege of Taiz, AFP sources say.

news.headline: LPG carrier struck a second time off Oman; crew abandon ship, one missing
news.summary: The Tara Gas, disabled while leaving Hormuz on 16 Nov, was hit again about 8 nm north-northeast of Khasab after Iran's navy reportedly warned it would strike if anyone helped; India says 24 crew are safe and one Indian seafarer is missing.

news.headline: Araghchi and Oman's Busaidi discuss Hormuz shipping in Muscat
news.summary: The foreign ministers discussed maritime security and reviving dialogue to prevent escalation, while Pakistan said it is still awaiting a delayed US reply to Iran's proposals.

news.headline: UK sanctions eight Israeli settlement builders and anti-aid group Tzav 9
news.summary: Britain imposed asset freezes on firms building in West Bank settlements and on a movement that has blocked aid to Gaza, in a move likely to strain ties with Israel.

news.headline: US jets strike IRGC missile site on Qeshm Island after drone attack on Bahrain base
news.summary: A US official called it self-defence after IRGC drones targeted a US radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain; IRNA reported five or six explosions on Qeshm, and Iran's armed forces claimed three tankers hit mines in the strait the same day.

news.headline: Trump in Manila says Iran deal 'very close', will press Xi and Putin
news.summary: After meeting Quad leaders, Trump said he would ask Xi and Putin to help end the Iran war and told ASEAN leaders 'We're with you always' before heading to Shenzhen for APEC.

news.headline: Seven Russian drones stray into Moldova, one spotted over Chisinau
news.summary: Five drones crashed near villages, one about 11 km from the capital, during Russia's mass attack on Ukraine; no one was hurt, and President Sandu said Moldova still lacks drone defences.

news.headline: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge collapse capped a seven-phase operation
news.summary: He said weeks of strikes first took out air defences and radars along the route; separately, fires were reported overnight at the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex in Bashkortostan amid a drone attack.

news.headline: Putin arrives in Shenzhen ahead of first Trump–Xi–Putin summit
news.summary: The Kremlin says the agenda for Thursday's three-way meeting at APEC is agreed, with nuclear arms and the Iran war expected to dominate; Trump flies in from Manila on Wednesday.

news.headline: Iran's army says its drones hit US Patriot systems at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem base
news.summary: Kuwait's air defences engaged hostile drones overnight and Iran's regular army called the attack retaliation for the US strike on Qeshm; damage is unverified, and Iran also claims it shot down a US drone over Hormuz.

news.headline: Drones reportedly hit Ilsky and Afipsky refineries in Russia's Krasnodar Krai
news.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels said both Seversky district refineries were struck in an attack that lasted through the night; Kyiv has not confirmed the strikes.

news.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 60 Houthi targets and stopped a cruise missile aimed at Riyadh
news.summary: Strikes hit Sanaa, Hodeidah, Saada and Amran as government forces reinforce Tur al-Baha, about 85 km from Aden, and clashes continue in Lahij and Taiz.

news.headline: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen, say China and Russia should lead a multipolar world
news.summary: The bilateral talks on the APEC sidelines came a day before the first Trump–Xi–Putin summit; Putin told APEC that Western powers are 'former hegemons'.

news.headline: GCC, Qatar and UAE condemn Iranian drone attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain
news.summary: The GCC urged the UN Security Council to act, and Kuwait cited its right to self-defence under Article 51 after repeated drone attacks.

news.headline: Quds Force chief Qaani in Iraq as Baghdad gives Kataib Hezbollah until Friday to leave Jurf al-Nasr
news.summary: Prime Minister al-Zaidi has sent more troops around the town in an oil-smuggling probe; a Kataib Hezbollah commander says the group will not withdraw.

news.headline: Board of Peace warns Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse
news.summary: In a report to the UN Security Council, the US-backed body said Israel and Hamas have both fallen far short of their commitments and that Israel is blocking the interim civil administration.

events.summary: A morning Russian strike on a road in Dnipro killed one person and injured 13, an hour after another strike damaged apartment buildings.
events.title: Strike on Dnipro road kills one, injures 13

events.summary: The Foreign Affairs Council listed 113 people and entities, including 47 banks and major refiners, and sanctioned a Kremlin troll factory and a hacker group.
events.title: EU ministers adopt new Russia sanctions

events.place: Near Abu Zabad, West Kordofan, Sudan
events.summary: Sudan's army says it seized five localities northeast of Abu Zabad from the RSF and advanced toward the town.
events.title: Army takes Al-Saatat areas

events.summary: Military sources say the Houthis took the Khor Omairah coast about 100 km west of Aden and are 25 km from government lines at Qawah.
events.title: Houthis seize coast west of Aden

events.summary: Araghchi said ECO states back Iran's plan to reopen Hormuz within two days if the US lifts its blockade; Pakistan awaits a US reply.
events.title: Iran pitches two-day Hormuz plan in Islamabad

events.summary: Estonia summoned Russia's charge d'affaires over an alleged GRU arson attempt on drone maker Threod Systems.
events.title: Estonia summons Russian envoy

events.summary: UKMTO said a tanker about 7 nm north of Khasab was left disabled with an engine-room fire; crew safe.
events.title: Tanker disabled north of Khasab

events.summary: Seven Russian ballistic missiles hit the North and South bridges, closing both and halting the metro's eastern Green Line section.
events.title: Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv's Dnipro bridges

events.summary: Three people were reported injured in Smila, Cherkasy Oblast, during the overnight Russian attack.
events.title: Missile strike on Smila

events.summary: An industrial infrastructure facility was hit and six strikes were reported in the region during the overnight attack.
events.title: Industrial site hit in Zaporizhzhia

events.summary: Trump joined the ASEAN summit's final day before heading to China to meet Xi and Putin.
events.title: Trump arrives in Manila for ASEAN

events.summary: Fires were reported at several points of the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex overnight amid reports of a Ukrainian drone attack; not independently verified.
events.title: Fires at Salavat petrochemical complex

events.summary: A section of the road bridge fell into the Kerch Strait after a reported Ukrainian strike; Russia suspended road and rail traffic.
events.title: Crimean Bridge span collapses

events.summary: The disabled LPG carrier was struck a second time and engulfed in flames; the crew abandoned ship and one seafarer is missing.
events.title: Tara Gas hit again off Khasab

events.summary: Araghchi and Busaidi discussed maritime security and reviving dialogue to prevent escalation.
events.title: Iran and Oman FMs meet on Hormuz

events.summary: The IRGC said it targeted a US radar at the base for the third time since Friday; Bahrain said the drones were intercepted with no casualties.
events.title: IRGC drones at US radar, Sheikh Isa Air Base

events.summary: A US official said fighter jets hit an IRGC missile launch site in self-defence; IRNA reported five or six explosions northwest of Qeshm city.
events.title: US jets strike IRGC missile site on Qeshm

events.summary: Trump said an Iran deal is 'very close' and he will press Xi and Putin to help end the war.
events.title: Trump meets Quad and ASEAN leaders

events.summary: Seven drones crossed into Moldova during Russia's attack on Ukraine, one over Chisinau; five crashed near villages, with no casualties.
events.title: Russian drones enter Moldovan airspace

events.summary: Putin landed ahead of Thursday's first three-way meeting with Trump and Xi, whose agenda the Kremlin says is agreed.
events.title: Putin arrives in Shenzhen for APEC

events.place: Ali Al Salem Air Base, Kuwait
events.summary: Kuwait's air defences engaged hostile drones and Iran's army said it targeted US Patriot systems at the base in retaliation for the Qeshm strike; damage is unverified.
events.title: Iranian drones target Ali Al Salem air base

events.summary: Ukrainian monitoring channels said both Seversky district refineries were struck overnight; Kyiv has not confirmed.
events.title: Drones reportedly hit Ilsky and Afipsky refineries

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed 60 Houthi military targets in Sanaa, Hodeidah, Saada and Amran.
events.title: Coalition hits 60 Houthi targets

events.summary: The coalition said it intercepted a Houthi cruise missile aimed at the Saudi capital as civil defence issued alerts in three regions.
events.title: Houthi cruise missile at Riyadh intercepted

events.summary: The two leaders said China and Russia should lead a push to a multipolar world, a day before the three-way summit with Trump.
events.title: Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen

events.summary: The Quds Force commander met Prime Minister al-Zaidi as Baghdad gave Kataib Hezbollah until Friday to leave Jurf al-Nasr.
events.title: Qaani in Baghdad over Jurf al-Nasr standoff
